skill_name: Explain to me the concept of relativity.
workflow: Relativity is the idea that physical phenomena (such as space and time) depend on the observer's reference frame. This means that the same event or measurement can be experienced differently depending on the observer's motion or speed, or the gravitational force affecting them.    Albert Einstein's theory of relativity proposed two postulates - the Special Theory of Relativity and the General Theory of Relativity.
